resources.string: Keep an encrypted copy of your vault in your own Google Drive, so you can get it back if you lose or change your phone. It stays off until you turn it on.
Using a new phone? Restore your vault with the recovery code you saved.
Vault backup can\'t connect to Google yet. Your vault still works and stays on this phone. Try again after the next update of Samvad.
Backing up to your Google Drive
Once a day, only when something changed.

Your backup is encrypted on this phone before it is uploaded. Google and Samvad can\'t read it. It is kept in a hidden folder in your Google Drive that only Samvad can open, and it uses your Drive storage.
Couldn\'t reach Google Drive. Check your internet connection and try again.
Your Google Drive storage is full. Free some space, then try again.
Samvad no longer has access to your Google Drive. Connect again to keep backing up.
Backup isn\'t set up yet. Your vault is safe on this phone.
This backup was made by a newer version of Samvad. Update the app, then try again.
That recovery code or passphrase doesn\'t open this backup. Check it and try again.
There is no Samvad backup in this Google account.
There isn\'t enough free space on this phone.
Unlock your vault and try again.
The vault was erased or replaced after backup was set up, so this backup can\'t be updated. Turn backup off, then set it up again.
The backup or its saved key couldn\'t be read. It may be damaged. Turn backup off and set it up again.
Google Drive is busy right now. Samvad will try again later.
Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
Samvad will delete your encrypted backup from Google Drive and stop backing up. Your vault on this phone is not changed. You can set up backup again later.
Backup is off. The copy was deleted from Google Drive.
The copy in your Google Drive was not deleted. You can turn backup off on this phone anyway. The copy stays in your Drive\'s hidden app data until you delete it there.
Backup is off on this phone.
Enter the recovery code or passphrase you saved when you set up backup. Items that are already in this vault are kept as they are.
Restoring your vault. This can take a few minutes for a large vault.
Nothing new to restore. Everything in the backup is already in this vault.
What is uploaded: your vault\'s files, notes and their titles, packed into one encrypted file.
It is encrypted on this phone before it leaves. Google and Samvad can\'t read it.
It goes to a hidden folder in your own Google Drive that only Samvad can open. It counts toward your Drive storage. Samvad asks Google for access to that folder only, not to your other files.
You will get a recovery code to keep. If you lose it, nobody can open the backup, including Samvad.
You can turn backup off, and delete it from Drive, at any time.
Choose how to protect your backup
Samvad makes a long random code for you to save. This is the strongest choice.
You choose a passphrase of at least 12 characters. It is only as strong as the words you pick.
Write it down or keep it in a safe place, such as a password manager. You need it to restore your vault on a new phone. Samvad doesn\'t keep a copy.
Code copied. Clear your clipboard once you have saved it.
Use at least 12 characters, with words only you would think of. If you forget it, the backup can\'t be opened.
Type these groups from the code you saved. This makes sure you can read it back later.
One of the groups doesn\'t match. Check what you saved.
